newsitem.title: USA: Kysor shares' trading to be suspended - NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Kysor shares' trading to be suspended - NYSE.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Monday trading in Kysor Industrial Corp's common stock would be suspended immediately, because of the number of Kysor shares held publicly.

The exchange, which said it would apply to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issue, said it considered suspending and removing a company's stock when fewer than 600,000 common shares were held by the public.
As a result of the completion of a tender offer by Scotsman Industries Inc, fewer than 600,000 shares of Kysor common remain publicly held, the exchange said.
It said it could suspend a security at any time if it believed continued dealings on the New York Stock Exchange were not advisable.
